_comment: ASCENSION CATALOG (plan-ascension.md C3 step 3, D9/D26): the frost nuke. ⭐ D1 WORLD-PARITY: every number is DamageBurst's (id 49) verbatim — cost, radius, damage, the negative cooldown slope. ⚑ THE ONE PLACE IT IS NOT A STRAIGHT RE-TYPE, recorded because it is a real balance difference rather than a flavour one: DamageBurst carries TWO tags (physical + bleed) and this carries ONE (frost), so against a target resisting neither they are identical, and against a mixed-resistance target they diverge in both directions. Single-tag was chosen over 'frost + bleed' because bleed is the elite-bandit line's identity and borrowing it would make this the strictly broader of the two. ⚑ displayName follows its parent's own convention (DamageBurst authors 'Damage-Burst'), which is the whole reason that override field exists. All values [PLACEHOLDER], and they move only if DamageBurst's move.
name: RimeBurst
